output.reason: The release note [ev-9413f4b657a9] only says an issue with mirror policies on waypoints was fixed. The linked issue [ev-9aa6075f3dd7] [ev-f1ecb696fc19] explains the issue: on a waypoint, request mirroring did not mirror traffic, whether it was set through an HTTPRoute RequestMirror filter or a VirtualService. With the fix, mirroring that was configured but ignored now takes effect, so the mirror backends start receiving traffic. Nothing fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind and the proposed statement, though vague, is accurate.
